rows.label: tlk70000021_05_msg0001
rows.name:
For now, mass-producing ships comes
first, but someday I want to build a
huge shipyard too.

rows.label: tlk70000021_05_msg0002
rows.name:
This job made me realize we need more
people and materials, and a place
where we can build ships efficiently.

rows.label: tlk70000021_05_msg0003
rows.name:
The more ships we build, the easier
it'll make things for others, so
it's worth putting in the effort.

rows.label: tlk70000021_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Anyway, I'll keep doing my best. You
keep at it too!
